name: Akshay Kumar Controlling Hand (Housefull 3)
visual_description: Akshay Kumar clenches his jaw with his head tilted back, desperately using one hand to restrain his outstretched other hand.
usage_context: Depicts extreme self-control while trying to stop oneself from doing or saying something impulsive, aggressive, or petty.

example.caption: Me stopping myself from saying 'Told you so' after warning them 10 times

text_areas.description: The impulsive urge or response being restrained
